name: Yamamoto Y.
about_me: Hi there! I’m currently based between Tokyo and Osaka, Japan (around 70% in Tokyo and 30% in Osaka), so I can share a lot about Japanese culture and everyday life in Japan. My entire house in Osaka is a traditional-style home, so you can enjoy a genuine Japanese atmosphere. (I also run two secret Airbnbs—one in Tokyo and one near Osaka, close to both Kobe and Kyoto! If you’re interested, feel free to ask me about them!) airbnb.com/h/jironoouchi The Tokyo room is small but cozy, with a unique blend of cultures. Even though it’s close to the city, it’s right by a beautiful natural area—so you get the best of both worlds! I’m an easygoing and laid-back person. I’ve only just started my journey of world travel, and I’m excited to experience new cultures and lifestyles. So far, I’ve visited several Asian countries, including Singapore, Indonesia, Vietnam, and Cambodia. In addition, I’ve traveled around Europe as well. In May 2024, I visited London, the Netherlands, Germany, Austria, Spain, and Turkey😆 More recently, in March 2025, I traveled to Finland, Helsinki, London, and the island of Malta🇲🇹 I also lived on the Gold Coast, Australia, for six months, so I’m comfortable communicating in English🇦🇺 Looking forward to meeting new people and sharing stories together!
